docs.description: an effect writes a state slot listed in its own deps array
docs.why: Writing a dep re-triggers the effect; unconditional writes loop forever.
docs.fix: Derive the value during render, or drop the slot from deps and use the functional updater.

rules.message: this effect writes {setter.slot}, which is in its own deps array

docs.description: a useMemo dep is recreated every render
docs.why: Object.is never matches a fresh reference, so the memo recomputes every render.
docs.fix: Hoist the literal, memoize it, or depend on its primitive parts.

rules.message: dep {dep.path} is {dep.stability}: this memo recomputes every render

docs.description: effect deps arrays are capped by team policy
docs.why: A long deps array usually means one effect doing several jobs.

rules.message: this effect declares more than {param.maxDeps} deps — split it by concern
